x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first combined memory and skill discovery command exceeded its bounded timeout.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Split memory lookup from skill discovery and use bounded literal-path probes.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Keep read-first discovery scalar and time-bounded before repository mutation.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A PowerShell login-profile Get-Item and memory search exceeded its bounded timeout.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Rerun the bounded read-only probes with login-profile loading disabled.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Use login=false for deterministic repository and memory probes.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A grouped source Git verification command exceeded its bounded timeout.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Audit path, branch, head, status, ancestry, and remote equality with scalar probes.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Separate local Git checks from live-remote checks and materialize each result.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first read targeted a nonexistent JSON auth schema instead of the current Markdown schema.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Resolve the schema filename from the selected skill and read the Markdown schema through EOF.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Enumerate exact referenced resources before reading a schema.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first inline Python manifest replay had a command-quoting syntax error.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Pass the bounded script through standard input and replay the manifest without changing source.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Avoid nested shell quoting for structured manifest checks.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first receipt projection assumed an older attempts-array shape and returned null fields.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Inspect the flat receipt keys and project the actual canonical aggregate fields.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Inspect receipt schema before projecting validation truth.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first branch and path existence preflight embedded native commands in an invalid PowerShell expression.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Run scalar native commands and capture explicit exit status values.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Keep PowerShell conditionals separate from native command invocations.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first grouped post-creation worktree audit exceeded its bounded timeout.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Split registration, branch, head, status, and process checks into scalar probes.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Use small bounded worktree audits after long checkout operations.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first frozen proposal projection assumed proposals or entries rather than prior_proposals and new_proposals.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Enumerate the index properties and join the two declared proposal arrays.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Inspect JSON property names before count or semantic projections.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The inherited evidence manifest declares one lifecycle exclusion for a path absent from the evidence commit; all committed evidence paths remain covered and the final owner and delta manifests are exact.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Retain the source audit mismatch at zero credit, use exact set-equality checks for Caelen manifests, and do not rewrite Sylven history.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Require declared exclusions plus entries to equal actual commit-local paths in every Caelen manifest.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first inherited Method Flow projection reached a Windows console encoding error while printing Māori text.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Set Python UTF-8 input and output encoding and rerun the read-only projection.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Set PYTHONUTF8 and PYTHONIOENCODING for all structured Python probes.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first x1 build assumed every inherited Method Flow state event used an after field, but retained older events use a to field.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Preserve both inherited event shapes and count the normalized after-or-to state.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Normalize mixed historical Method Flow event shapes only at read time; never rewrite inherited events.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The second x1 build exceeded its bounded timeout while repeatedly asking Git to rediscover the same large untracked candidate set.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Enumerate the bounded Caelen phase root plus the three phase scripts and x1 test deterministically.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Use one owner-path inventory for build, review, privacy, and manifest generation.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first grouped process and Git-status audit after the x1 build timeout also exceeded its bounded timeout.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Separate process inspection from repository status and avoid a full untracked status walk.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Audit timeout aftermath with small scalar probes and bounded owner-path enumeration.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A scalar PowerShell process audit exceeded its bounded timeout during temporary host load.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Treat the build invocation as terminated by the command boundary and continue only with deterministic owner-local reads.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not retry expensive host-wide process enumeration when bounded repository checks suffice.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A native read-only task-list filter also exceeded its bounded timeout during temporary host load.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Stop host-wide process probing and rely on the next bounded builder exit plus later Git lock and exact-state checks.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Escalate to process inspection only if a concrete Git lock or mutation conflict appears.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first exact staged-blob replay found the privacy-scan blob had changed after the manifest entry was computed.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Audit the producing process, stop concurrent writes, rebuild from frozen inputs, and replay every staged blob hash.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Require a zero-writer check and exact staged-blob replay before committing x1.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The timed-out x1 builder remained live and continued owner-local Git discovery and file rewrites after its command boundary.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Resolve its exact PID and command line, stop only that stale builder and its confirmed Git child, then rebuild once.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: After any timeout, audit the exact command-line process before accepting generated artifacts.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A grouped unstaged-diff and exact-process audit exceeded its bounded timeout after the staged hash replay.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use git diff-files and an exact Python command-line process filter as separate scalar probes.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Keep large-worktree index checks separate from host process inspection.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A combined large-worktree diff-files and untracked probe exceeded its bounded timeout after the exact staged replay.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Rely on the exact staged manifest now and perform clean-state checks as separate long-timeout probes after commit.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Never combine large-worktree cleanliness and untracked enumeration in one bounded command.
